subject.title: feat(system-agent): auto-hatch into the agent after fresh setup

question: Should the gateway handoff contract add an explicit hatch-specific discriminator rather than overload the generic `open-agent` action for this new onboarding behavior?
rationale: The UI cannot reliably infer a fresh setup hatch from the existing generic action, and a durable fix changes the handoff protocol/API shape rather than only correcting a local conditional.

options.title: Add an explicit hatch handoff signal
options.body: Introduce an additive typed signal for the fresh-setup hatch, preserve the current session in the web navigation, and leave ordinary agent handoffs unchanged.

options.title: Keep generic handoffs unchanged
options.body: Defer the web hatch draft until there is an approved protocol shape that distinguishes it from normal agent-chat navigation.

recommendation.title: Add an explicit hatch handoff signal
recommendation.body: Introduce an additive typed signal for the fresh-setup hatch, preserve the current session in the web navigation, and leave ordinary agent handoffs unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently delivered the adjacent custodian onboarding surface and authored this handoff proposal.
